name: ralphy
description: Ralphy watches trends in your niche, runs a local panel for your content and accounts, and posts to your own accounts through your coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Trends, content and your own accounts
interface.longDescription: Ralphy gives your coding agent a trend base, a local panel with Content and Accounts, and the ability to post to your own accounts. The agent drives the open-source ralphy CLI with your own provider keys.
defaultPrompt: Use Ralphy to find what is trending in my niche this week.
Use Ralphy to make a short video from a script that works in a trend reference.
